finding.title: Creating biased random numbers from a cryptographically secure source

precision.math: 256 is divisible by32; exhaustively enumerating all byte values gives8 values per existing index. Therefore current32-symbol mapping does not itself demonstrate modulo distribution bias. The historical warning is still removed by switching to a bounded cryptographic primitive, including protection if the alphabet length changes later.

No alert dismissal, severity reduction or suppression.
